description.narrative: MADRE is an international human rights organization that resources partners across the globe, and fosters a world rooted in feminist values, where women and girls, and other marginalized groups, fully participate in shaping policies and decision making, their expertise and leadership is recognized and upheld, and they equitably hold power and resources within their communities. The current and chronic crisis in Israel and the ongoing genocide in Palestine - the spread gender-based violence among women and girls, displacement, and shortages of food, water and medicines - is leading to a humanitarian catastrophe across communities in the region. Through our partnership, MADRE will: - Provide grants to partners in Palestine, as well as other affected areas, to meet the urgent needs of the most at-risk communities impacted by conflict, as well as to support individuals and their families experiencing forced displacement; - Fund partners to continue their work, ensuring that the crisis does not derail years of service delivery, human rights organizing, and institution-building by women's organizations at the local level; and - Accompany meeting immediate needs with advocacy, policy, and strategic communications support, including work to model components of a peaceful resolution, and demand life-saving interventions, including a ceasefire, the establishment of aid corridors, and the restoration of critical services to Gaza. - Advance a strategy on Advocacy, Policy and communications that center MADRE's partners needs, ceasefire and peacebuilding solutions.
